catalysts.headline: Roblox reported Q3 2026 results after market close: GAAP EPS -$0.32 (beat consensus of roughly -$0.40 to -$0.43); revenue $1.57B (+16% YoY from $1.36B), reported as a slight miss vs. ~$1.62B consensus; bookings $1.697B, down 12% YoY from $1.922B but above the high end of the company's own -14% to -18% guidance; GAAP net loss $230M (narrower than $258M a year ago); adjusted EBITDA $138M; free cash flow $364M. Daily active user growth reportedly turned negative (~-9%) for the first time. Q4 bookings guidance calls for a 10-15% YoY decline. Shares fell roughly 17% after hours despite the EPS/bookings beat.

Delayed market reaction to 'Roblox Everywhere' platform announcements from the prior week's developer conference (cross-platform distribution, offline play, AI dev tools), amplified by a round of Wall Street price-target hikes (e.g., Wedbush)
Alongside Q2 2026 results, Roblox guided bookings down as much as 18% for the following quarter and withdrew its full-year bookings outlook
catalysts.impact: Significant negative guidance change layered on top of the Q2 EPS beat/revenue-miss print already on file
